text: A weekly Spark job needs thirty minutes of processing, and data must survive compute deletion. Which comparison is most relevant to operating cost?

text: A query optimization reduces logical bytes scanned by 80%. The team uses capacity-based compute. What cost conclusion is justified?

choices.html: Catch every task error and report success to downstream consumers.

choices.html: 33 minutes, measured from the latest known recoverable state.

choices.html: 4 minutes, because completion duration always equals RPO.

explanation: Use the state that is actually known recoverable at failure time. The loss exposure in this explicit example is 10:03 minus 09:30, independent of the duration of the incomplete later copy.
